title: Filter Users with computed
short_description: Practice deriving filtered UI state with computed instead of manually updating a second value.
description: In this challenge, you will complete a small user filter component using Vue's computed function.
The goal is to derive filteredUsers from search and users, letting Vue recalculate the list only when its reactive dependencies change.
instructions: Turn filteredUsers into a computed property.
Filter users by comparing each name against search.value in a case-insensitive way.
Complete clearSearch so the search returns to its initial state.

hints.title: Bring in computed
hints.body: `computed` and `ref` can share the same named import from `vue`

hints.title: Derive, do not duplicate
hints.body: Assign `filteredUsers` to a `computed` call whose function reads `users.value` and `search.value`. You do not need another `ref` for the filtered list.

hints.title: Normalize the search
hints.body: Normalize the search text with `trim()` and `toLowerCase()`. Return every user when it is empty; otherwise, use `filter()` and `includes()` against lowercase names.

hints.title: Restore the search
hints.body: In `clearSearch`, return the search ref to its initial empty string. Remember that refs are updated with `.value` inside `<script setup>`
